contexts.text: A vine, in the Word, = spiritual good. Illustrated.
Thy wife like a fruitful vine () = the Spiritual Church.
As a vineyard = the Spiritual Church, so does a vine, because a vine belongs to a vineyard... Illustrated. AC 1071:2. AC 2702:14.

As a vine = the Spiritual Church, and as charity is the primary of the Spiritual Church, in which primary the Lord is present, and through which He conjoins Himself with man, and through which He alone operates all good, the Lord compares Himself to a vine, and describes the man of the Church, or the Spiritual Church, in these words: I am the true Vine, and My Father is the Vine-dresser, every branch in Me that beareth not fruit, He taketh away... I am the Vine, ye are the branches... ().
The Lord is called a vine out of Egypt () as to the Knowledges in which He was instructed.
A vine is predicated of truths and of falsities... thus the vine of Sodom () = falsity from evil.
Groves of olives = the celestial things of worship; groves of vines, its spiritual things...
Vine, and noble vine () = the Spiritual Church external and internal.
The adoption of the spiritual is described in... I am the Vine, ye are the branches... A vine = the Spiritual Church.
A vine out of Egypt = truth from scientifics.
The vine shall give her fruit () = that the Spiritual of the Church will give good.
The vine and fig () = the goods of faith (as distinguished from the goods of love).
Some species of trees = interior goods and truths, which are of the spiritual (as distinguished from the natural) man, such as olives and vines.
In the Ancient Church... the vine, and the derivative wine = the things which are of charity, and of the faith from this.
A noble vine () = spiritual good. ( = the good of faith of the Spiritual Church. AC 9139:4.)
Lo a vine before me () = the Intellectual of the Spiritual Church. AC 5113:4, Illustrated.
A noble vine () = the man of the Spiritual Church, who is called a vine from what is intellectual. The degenerate branches of a strange vine () = the man of a perverted Church.

Its becoming a luxuriant vine, and a vine of magnificence () = becoming a Spiritual Church, which is called a vine from the derivative wine, signifying spiritual good, or the good of charity, from which is the truth of faith implanted in the intellectual part. ( = the external and internal Spiritual Church. AC 8764:6.) AE 281:2.
The vine () = the Intellectual which is of the Spiritual Church; and the noble vine = the Intellectual which is of the Celestial Church.

A vine out of Egypt, in the supreme sense, = the Lord; the glorification of His Human being described by it and its branches. In the internal sense, a vine, here, = the Spiritual Church, and the man of this Church, such as he is when... regenerated as to the Intellectual and the Voluntary. AC 9341:2.
A vine = the good of the Intellectual... or, what is the same, the good of the interior man. Illustrated.
That a vine = the Intellectual made new, or regenerated, through good from truth, and through truth from good. Illustrated. (These) are signified by the fruit of the vine-genimen vitis ().

As the Intellectual of the spiritual man is... regenerated through the truth which is from the Lord alone, the Lord compares Himself to a Vine; and those who are being implanted in the truth which is from Him, and consequently in Him, He compares to the branches; and the derivative good, to the fruit.
As, in the supreme sense, a vine = the Lord as to Divine truth; and, from this, in the internal sense, the man of the Spiritual Church, a vineyard = the Spiritual Church itself.
See Nazarite.
And in the vine three shoots () = the derivative derivations down to the ultimate one. A vine = the Intellectual. Explained.
No grapes in the vine () = no interior or rational good.

He binds his young donkey to the vine () = (conjunction through) truth in the Natural for the external Church... A vine = the Spiritual Church; here, the external Spiritual Church, because a choice vine = the internal Church. AE 433:4.
And his donkey's colt unto the choice vine () = (through) truth from the Rational for the internal Church. Explained. AE 433:4.
A vine = the Spiritual Church, and consequently the good of truth. References.
A vine () = the truth and good of the internal Church.
Gourds from a wild vine () = falsification. ( = falsities. AC 10105:3.)
A vine = the Spiritual Church.
To vintage the vine of the earth () = to consume the truth and good of the Church. (Compare AC 5113:2, AR 649, and AE 918.)
The Lord called Himself a Vine (because) a vine = faith in the Lord, and consequently the Lord as to faith; for the Lord is faith because faith is from Him...
A vine () = spiritual good.
A vine = the good of the Spiritual Church.
A vine = the Church. References.
A vine = the truth and good of the Spiritual Church.
A vine = the interior good of the Spiritual Church.
A vine = a Church which is in spiritual good.
A vine = the good of the internal Spiritual church.
References.
The olive, the vine, the cedar, etc. = the celestial, spiritual, rational, etc. good and truth of the Church.
An olive = the good of love; a vine, truth from this good.
(A garden seen which contained vines, etc. in order.)
An olive (seen) the trunk of which was entwined with a vine.
The leaves of an olive and of a vine = rational truths from celestial and spiritual light.
Trees twined round with tendrilled vines, seen. CL 75:2.
Between olive and olive, running and pendulous vines.
Faith without Truths is like a vine which bears wild grapes.
Silver, a sapphire, and a vine, in the Word, = spiritual good, which is the good of the Middle Heaven.
The fruit of the vine = the truth of the New Church and Heaven. ( = Divine truth from Divine good, and the derivative bliss and happiness. AE 252:6.) AE 376:26.
A vine = the internal Church, thus the internal things of the Church.
The vine in the field () = the truths of the Church.
The vine shall languish () = that the truth (of the Spiritual Church) will cease... The vine = spiritual truth. AE 376:20.
The vine = the Church. AE 433:30.
A vine = the Spiritual Church from the affection of truth.
A thousand vines () = truths from good in abundance.
The vine shall give its fruit () = that truth will produce good... For a vine = the Church as to truths, or the truths of the Church.
Vine and fig-tree () = good and truth from a spiritual origin.
A noble vine () = spiritual truth from what is celestial, or truth from the good of love. ( = genuine truths. AE 918:4.)
Vine corresponds to spiritual good, which in its essence is truth.
wine = the doctrine itself (of the Spiritual, Church).
Vine = the Church as to truth, which is called the Spiritual Church. AE 618:7.
I will lay waste her vine () = the internal Church which is of the spiritual man.
Israel is an empty vine () = the Church when there is no longer any truth.
In general, the vine = the Spiritual which is of truth from good... In the spiritual sense, the vine = the Spiritual Church.
The vine = the internal Church.
The vine = spiritual good and truth.
No produce on the vines () = no spiritual good.

Therefore it is said of those who are in the goods and truths of the Church, and thus in safety from evils and falsities, that they shall sit in safety under their vine and fig-tree, and none shall make afraid. Illustrated.
The vine = the internal or spiritual things of the Church. AE 403:13. AE 638:21.
A vine out of Egypt = the Spiritual Church, which begins with man through scientifics and Knowledges in the natural man. AE 518:16, Explained. AE 569:14.
To plant a vine = to establish a spiritual Church.
The vine = the spiritual good and truth of the Church.
The vine = the spiritual truth of the Church. AE 503:5. AE 717:3.

Thy mother is like a vine () = the Ancient Church, which was in the good of life and the derivative truths. ( = that the Spiritual Church, from its establishment, had been instructed in truths. AE 727:3.)
Their vine is of the vine of Sodom () = the Church (in) all evils from the love of self.
It reduces my vine to a waste () = destroying spiritual truths, which are those of the spiritual sense of the Word.
The vine = the truth of doctrine of the Church.
There are three trees which principally = the Church: the olive, the vine, and the fig;... the vine = the Spiritual Church.
Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine... = the Church as to the affection of truth.
The vine = the truth of celestial good.
The vine = the Church as to the spiritual affection of truth.
Behold, and visit this vine () = the Spiritual Church.
Vine and fig-tree = an internal and external Spiritual Church. AE 911:14.
The vine of Sibmah = the Church (formed of men of the external Church who explain the Word to favour worldly loves).
The wood of the vine = spiritual good.
